title: Insurance injection compensates current LP holders, not drawdown-era holders (JIT capture)
root_cause: attemptInjectPool credits the live pool (applyDeltaToPoolAmount) on drawdown, raising the price for whoever holds LP at injection time; the reserve was meant for LPs who bore the drawdown, so a JIT LP depositing after the drawdown captures insurance compensation it never lost.
attacker_entrypoint: market realizes drawdown (traders win); reserve funded over the epoch
attacker_capabilities: deposit LP after a realized drawdown, before/at injection (async GMX deposit)

severity_justification.worst_case: JIT LPs systematically skim the insurance reserve from drawdown-era LPs.
severity_justification.realistic_case: Bounded by async deposit timing/fees; a real value-distribution flaw.
severity_justification.program_table_mapping: see official program impact table (not bundled)

bounty_program_mapping.scope_reference: 0xMarkets contest (0xMarkets_contract-main @ e94daee); GMX Synthetics fork (ships GMX audits).

call_trace: market realizes drawdown (traders win); reserve funded over the epoch
JIT LP deposits after the drawdown
attemptInjectPool injects reserve into the pool -> raises price for current holders incl. the JIT LP
JIT LP withdraws, capturing a share of insurance compensation it never lost
